[quote=qianxun;60291125][spoiler=[b]Blood in the Sand[/b]]

The Astaniran Democratic Movement has accepted Qianxuns aid, even as the hammer and sickle stands ominously in the foreground of its backing. The Socialist Ethics Commission is pleased by developments and would submit the coded document back to general secretary Cui Fang. As Qianxun forces began to unload by the hundreds on the beaches of Democratic Astanir, the Weilai clique and the five minor parties of the Qianxun State Assembly could only hold their breaths as the state made ready to let Qianxun blood spill on foreign soil for the first time in its revolutionary history. But the time for drastic action is not yet.

[list]

How much longer for the planes? asked the woman, carefully cleaning the inside of her disassembled rifle.

At this rate, another week. the man replied as he put on his vest and inserted his ceramic plates. Dems took their sweet time with accepting freebies, so the ships had to wait and refuel.

Aww...

[/list]

The woman huffed before finally finishing her cleaning, raising her weapon up in the air, then shaking it haphazardly, letting the displaced dirt and grime accumulated within to fall to the floor in a thin pile. Then, leaning into the mirror, she smiled to check if her face seemed presentable to the cameras, her sharpened teeth sticking out ominously in the glare of the rooms lights. Seemingly satisfied, she turned to the man again as she began reassembling her rifle.

[list]

This place looks rough. she says. Dems look like theyve just dug-in and were waiting for something good to happen. Ya think Emzep made the right decision in having us go here? I mean, I appreciate the paycheck, but...

But?

Well, we aint even sure the Dems are gonna let Emzep do what they want. Youve seen these guys right? They aint commies.

[/list]

The man sighed. Ultimately, this whole operation was a farce in a way. Qianxun had resolved to save what it determined to be the only chance for democracy on this war-torn island. But SummitONE knew differently. They will land their troops, planes will fly over the Astaniran skies, and aid will begin feeding the starving men, women, and children of the land, but only on the condition that they let the hammer and sickle strike down on the institutions that they were striving to protect.

But a SummitONE operative was above these petty squables. A SummitONE fighter was smart enough to identify the evil and hypocrisy but to permit it if it meant they can be paid and fed to fight another day. The man knew that and so simply shrugged. He had seen plenty of this before, after all. The mans name was David Cyriacus, callsign Chicken Little. He was the Vespurian vice-president of SummitONE Solutions and a vetaran of the Sikirskian Civil War, now a Qianxun soldier of fortune. He knew carnage and had fought in it before. 

[list]

At the end of the day, the job of SummitONE is to fight and die for our pay. Cyriacus says bluntly. Good decisions, bad decisions, let our employers sort out which is what. Were no active agent and we aint got to choose which way is gonna save the most folks.

You sound mighty philosophical for a child killer, Mr. Vice. The woman quipped, chuckling to herself. Whatever, look Ill do the job, but Emzep better stabilize things quickly. These Dems dont look like they know how to govern a household, let alone a country.

[/list]

As the woman finished speaking, a loud thump, and then a crunch. The doors of the small vessel swung open, falling firmly down onto the white sands of Astanir. They had arrived. Cyriacus looked at the woman clearly in the eye and nodded. Alright, operations manager Freya Moran. He says, The job is simple. Interchange with the Democratic movement using the operations teams well be sending you. We have 2,000 men from SummitONE, Qunarco, and Miwu, as well as enough foreign aid to keep the Shamatine continent fed for the next century. Distribute everything and effectively to every single person you see, dont bother with keeping tabs for repeat claimants. We want the Astanirans to think and believe that Qianxun has their back, when their own institutions could not.

[list]

Aye! Freya says, making a mock salute. And those agents Qianxun wanted us to bring along?

Let them do their thing. From here on out, you are not SummitONE, but Pax international. Do your job beautifully and in the morning well swap out the company water supply for champagne. Now, get the hell outta here.

[/list]
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Revolution by any means[/b]]

The Qianxun diplomats, satisfied with this arrangement, would quickly arrive in Kuwalkti to present their offer of support. The man nominally heading the talks was a certain Qiu Guang, a nameless, faceless bureaucrat sent by the Min Zhu Party Central Committee. Rather than conducting the preliminary discussions with the Democratic forces through his own merit, Qiu would instead defer to a Vespurian man who had arrived with him, who didnt even wear the official Qianxun business attire, but rather an aid workers uniform. The man was David Cyriacus, who was the true representative of Qianxuns interests in Astanir and the actual head of Pax International [i]ex officio[/i] through his control of its largest component, SummitONE Solutions.

Cyriacuss request was simple: Independent control of the workers hell be bringing along onto Democratic territory, as well as permission for the Qianxun Socialist Republic to conduct field investigations into Astanirs local population to collate statistical data necessary to optimize its distribution of aid. In secret, however, these field investigations were to facilitate the construction of a socialist party in Astanir as per the demands of the Qianxun Socialist Ethics Commission.

The demands were audacious, especially for a power that had decided to intervene in the conflict only now. So audacious, that general secretary Cui Fang had warned Cyriacus that if the Democratic forces would not deny them, they would at least take precious time to come to a final decision. And so, as Cyriacus was conducting talks in Kuwalkti, in private he would give Pax International the greenlight to start unloading materials onto Astanir even without the Democratic Councils permission, forcing them into a [i]fait accompli[/i].

The rationale behind this move was simple: If aid was to be distributed prematurely, who was going to take it away? Here was a starving child, handed a hot meal by the generous Pax Intl aid workers. Who is to tell him that he wasnt supposed to receive it yet? And for the Democratic soldiers, here were Qianxuns latest inventory of tanks, medicine, ammunition, supplies. Is the Democratic Council supposed to say that these cannot be used for now, even as their frontlines continue to crumble in the face of the Junta and National Armys onslaught?

With the greenlight received, Pax International would land on Astaniran soil and quickly get to work. 

In total, the first Qianxun ships carried around 10,000 men, 2,000 of which were field technicians that were to attach itself to the Democratic forces. The so-called Chief of Field Operations for Pax Intl was a certain woman named Freya Moran, a notorious Vespurian contractor who won some degree of fame for her antics protecting the Bobian Republic from the Kaiserreich roughly a year ago. She was also part of the SummitONE squad that arrived in Sal-Baliz, but ultimately left early before actual military operations there began.

Her task was simple: Win hearts and minds in the Democratic territories, splatter hearts and minds everywhere else. Pax Intl brought along food and water aid, most of them MREs created during SummitONEs operations in Sal-Baliz, and thus were expected to perfectly fulfill the cultural sensitivities of the Astaniran people. Rather than transferring this aid to the Democratic forces and risking corruption, Pax Intl would resort to distributing aid themselves, distributing aid stamps which Astanirans could exchange for food and water, as well as aid certificates which could be exchanged for tents and building materials to help with housing.

On the military front, Pax Intl would organize its field technicians into four aid battalions and one headquarters. Most of Pax Intl armed forces would consist of Qianxun and Hsinyuan contractors, while the bulk of the active leadership and officers would actually be Elseyro-Vespurians, chiefly from the state of Norrhollow in which SummitONE is based at. Qianxun itself had specifically resolved to have the Vespurians be more visible than the Qianxun for this operation in order to better sell the idea that Pax International was an international humanitarian organization, but to what extent this facade could be sustained was left in the hands of public opinion.

Due to fueling issues, SummitONEs inventory jets will take a few more days to arrive at Astanir, and so Pax Intl would focus on its land capabilities first. In total, around 18 ZTQ-11 light tanks, 50 ZSL-93 APCs, and 31 ZBL-07 IFVs would be supplied by Qianxun for the preliminary phase of the operation, which would be roughly enough firepower to keep Pax Intl operational for at least two major battles, with more supplies arriving by the day. 65,000 more men are anticipated to arrive together with the rest of the shipments, in particular the Wuying-89 fighter jets, which shall be crucial in turning the tide of battle and helping the Democratic forces break out of its problematic pocket.

Elsewhere, Pax Intl would also deploy Qianxun agents from the Socialist Ethics Commission to investigate Astaniran political attitudes in Democratic territory, hoping to single out any intellectuals, labor activists, and industry leaders who were open and willing to head a left-leaning political party organized under Qianxuns political direction.[/spoiler][/quote]

Walking into this meeting Haru knew he would have to be leniant. This was a one-time opportunity and even a singular slipup could make it come crashing down around him.

Haru would allow Cyriacus Independent control over his workers, as well as for Qianxun teams to conduct their investigations, despite knowing that he now had no control over what his population could be exposed to. Initially council member Sjuri would objective, rather passionately, to Cyriacus's requests, but the power of democracy would outweigh his voice.

After the meeting, Haru would be informed by Democratic scouts across his territory that Pax international had begun offloading aid and water supplies around 4 hours prior to the council's final decision. Haru would dismiss this as simply anticipating the council's decision in good will. Afterall, the whole of Astanir has a severe humanitarian crisis on it's hands, only a psychopath could deny aid in such a time.

The democratic forces would accept the new equipment provided to them graciously. As the Qianxun soldiers began teaching the Astanirans how to use their newly aquired weaponry, it would become evident that the two races got along quite well. Pax international would easily be able to win over the soldiers and who could stand in their way after that? The soldiers were the driving force behind thi faction and would continue to do so for as long as it called itself democratic. 

As Pax international began it's work across Democratic territory, the next issue would make itself apparent in Haru's mind. Governance. The faction could not continue to be ruled solely by the council, they would become complacent, inefficient, corrupt. Over the course of the next week, Haru and his council would begin drafting documents, the formation of a constitution and a government, followed by political parties and criminal processes. Everything needed for a democratic country to function. The decision to allow the formation of political parties would be critical. It could make or break this faction, Haru can only wait...

Trade deal

1.a: Both parties agree to open their civilian markets for free trade between each others nations to encourage the flow of goods, service and refined materials.

1.b: All trade are to be done in "good fait" and with fair prices based on world market prices on a quarterly basis.

1.c: If there should be a large change or upsett in the world economy the trade prices can be changed outside of the quarterly basis if both nations agree.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

2.b: Tartakum opens its resource market for Copper to Nordiheim for them to buy these resourses with currency of equal value.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Military purchases

3.a: Nordiheim will allow Tartakum to buy 'TED-3-B' Flash grenades, 'MSR-75' sniper rifles and 'HM-DSB 10' light weigth signal booster as they need on a quarterly bassis.

3.b: Tartakum is also allowed to buy amunition fo the 'MSR-75' aswell as spare parts and technical advice on how to use the 'HM-DSB 10' propperly.

3.c: Nordiheim agrees with the signing of this deal to deliver any remaining quanteties that are left of a allready agreed quarterly order if this trade deal were to be canceled for any reason exept for the event were the Oceanice Republics were to proclaim direct hostile intent or declare war ageinst the nation of Nordiheim.

3.d: Tartakum will not be allowed to sell, give or donate any of the 'MRS-75', TED-3-B', 'HM-DSB 10' or their parts to another nation without the permsiion of the council of Nordiheim with the exeption of members of EEHP.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Other deals

4.a: Nordiheim will be allowed to invest in the mining companies of Tartakum in return for a % share in the companies.

4.b: The ownership of majorety share (51%) will not be allowed to be gained by Nordiheim or Nordiheimian companies/organizations, allowing them only a tottal ownership of 49% in any singular Tartakum company.

5: Both nations will be allowed to open embassies in each others national capitols.

6: In the interest of cooperation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Tartakum be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of 'The Copper Gun Deal' as long as both parties can arive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[b]There's no such thing as a free lunch[/b]

So long as people believe that good persists in a world that does not permit it, there will be subversion. Everywhere and anywhere, the veneer of humanity masks the two truths of human nature: Destroy and conquer.

Pax International gave out its aid freely. The aid workers smiled as they handed boxes to the starving Astaniran children in the town square, ripping open the plastic packaging and letting cans and bottles spill beneath. Field technicians wandered the city streets of the Democratic strongholds, pointing out structural issues and water contaminations. White tents spring up on the site of buildings that no longer existed as the EMTs and aid workers of Pax Int'l made their rounds transfusing blood, inserting IVs, opening suture kits, and enabling the weak and dying a place of hope, if not for life, then at least a dignified death on a comfortable bed.

Destroy and conquer with kindness to invite.

The aid workers singled out the good and able, those who were not starved and could eat without worry of refeeding syndrome, or who were sly enough to greet them for seconds and thirds. Field technicians pointed out which buildings were most appropriate as fortifications and interviewed individuals who were most privy to establish a party friendly to the interests of the Qianxun state. Doctors sent agents to meet with the relatives of the deceased, so that as they grieve the fallen they might be galvanized to exact misery upon the living.

Destroy and conquer if you must save yourself.

On the frontlines of this terrible war, Freya Moran organized her troops well according to Cyriacus's orders. Astanirans who were willing to fight were recruited in droves, their hastily-printed ID cards inserted deeply into their new uniforms. Pax Int'l could not risk losing its Qianxun and Vespurian troops, for if they were to die with rifles in their hands, the whole organization would lose credibility. Sacrifice had to come from the Astanirans themselves, who had been trained to operate Qianxun weaponry and armaments.

First there were 10,000 Elseyro-Vespurians and Qianxun technicians, then 35,000, then 60,000. Then, the final shipment, and Pax Int'l would swell into a gigantic force, 75,000 men strong. And it was not yet, for Freya waited for more Astanirans to appear and pledge to back the righteous and humanitarian cause of Pax. More fodder, more ID cards, more training camps, more men, and soon Pax Int'l was its own army. Let democracy be done, says the Pax worker, but the Qianxun agents waited amongst them, picking out those that were not privy to the ideals of the socialist resistance.

Destroy and conquer for the end near in sight.

The first Wuying-89 fighter jets started arriving. Cyraicus, still at the comforts of Democratic Headquarters, instructed Freya to act with caution. They could not afford to waste time teaching the Astanirans to operate these jets, so the Elseyro-Vespurians and Qianxun will have to do. Yet, one death, one shootdown, and they will be exposed. Qianxun agents come up to Pax Int'l and inform them on the Astaniran way of life, their dress, phrases, and diets, and so the designated pilots would don the Astaniran attire. It looked terrible, but at a glance, at a far enough distance perhaps the enemy will be fooled. Who would be stupid enough to approach a downed jet?

Tanks and APCs and IFVs arrive. Some are immediately forked over to the Democratic forces, but many more are kept in Pax hands, who already knew how they are used. Three infantry divisions of five brigades each are prepared to organized the ranks of Pax Int'l, plus many more auxiliary companies of the Astanirans seeking to fight. March south and save the Democratic enclave, then split the junta forces in two. Then, march west and triumph over the defeated enemy. Democracy must triumph in order for the red flag of socialism to fly over all.

Destroy and conquer until nothing is left.

The jets are scrambled. There had to have been 30 of them, flying one by one through the makeshift railways, consisting of interlocking aluminum planks laid down by volunteers. The duty was simple: Eliminate any visible SAM sites identified by SummitONE's tiny navy and satellites, tear through the junta's airbases, then return home safely. Qianxun confidence in its air force cannot be account for, when much of its fabled history has been sought in the glorious battle over land. But perhaps they will manage.

Meanwhile, back in the Democratic forces's [i]de facto[/i] capital, Qianxun began distributing red flags and emblems to build ground for what's to come.

The Copper Gun Trade
Trade deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Republic of Tartakum
====================================================
With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Tartakum agree to adhere to the following agreements of trade:
_C__________________________________G____________________________________T_
Trade deal

1.a: Both parties agree to open their civilian markets for free trade between each others nations to encourage the flow of goods, service and refined materials.
1.b: All trade are to be done in "good fait" and with fair prices based on world market prices on a quarterly basis.

1.c: If there should be a large change or upsett in the world economy the trade prices can be changed outside of the quarterly basis if both nations agree.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Resource deal

2.a: Nordiheim opens its resource market for Iron and Aluminium to Tartakum for them to buy this resourses with currency of equal value.
2.b: Tartakum opens its resource market for Copper to Nordiheim for them to buy these resourses with currency of equal value.

2.c: The Value of the Iron, Aluminium and Copper will be based on world market prices that will be agreed on in quarterly intervalls together with the quantities of each resource.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Military purchases

3.a: Nordiheim will allow Tartakum to buy 'TED-3-B' Flash grenades, 'MSR-75' sniper rifles and 'HM-DSB 10' light weigth signal booster as they need on a quarterly bassis.
3.b: Tartakum is also allowed to buy amunition fo the 'MSR-75' aswell as spare parts and technical advice on how to use the 'HM-DSB 10' propperly.

3.c: Nordiheim agrees with the signing of this deal to deliver any remaining quanteties that are left of a allready agreed quarterly order if this trade deal were to be canceled for any reason exept for the event were the Oceanice Republics were to proclaim direct hostile intent or declare war ageinst the nation of Nordiheim.

3.d: Tartakum will not be allowed to sell, give or donate any of the 'MRS-75', TED-3-B', 'HM-DSB 10' or their parts to another nation without the permsiion of the council of Nordiheim with the exeption of members of EEHP.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Other deals

4.a: Nordiheim will be allowed to invest in the mining companies of Tartakum in return for a % share in the companies.
4.b: The ownership of majorety share (51%) will not be allowed to be gained by Nordiheim or Nordiheimian companies/organizations, allowing them only a tottal ownership of 39% in any singular Tartakum company.

5: Both nations will be allowed to open embassies in each others national capitols.

6: In the interest of cooperation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Tartakum be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of 'The Copper Gun Deal' as long as both parties can arive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Signatory parties
Diplomatic delegation of The United Regions of Nordiheim ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Sr. Foreign Service Officer of The Republic of Tartakum [/spoiler]

While it will take some time to gain a full return on investment on some parts of this trade deal it is generally seen as a good deal with high potential for proffitable return on investment for both nations.
